description: This PHP script handles fetching and displaying email attachment images from a mailbox. It retrieves parameters from the request, uses the MailBox class to access mailbox data, decodes the image body as needed, and outputs it with the correct content type header.

classes.name: MailBox
classes.description: A class representing a mailbox, providing methods to access mailbox features, initialized with a mailbox name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the MailBox class, initializes connection or setup with the given mailbox name.
